meta.title: New York FEMA Public Assistance Recovery Monitor
meta.geographyNote: The snapshot includes all OpenFEMA Public Assistance funded projects with stateAbbreviation = NY. NYC-related is an analyst-constructed subset based on five-borough county, applicant city, and documented NYC entity name patterns. It is not an official FEMA or City of New York classification.

identifier.note: gmProjectId is present and unique for every New York row. Portfolio totals sum federalShareObligated across rows without collapsing.

meta.disclaimer: Independent analytical prototype using public OpenFEMA data. Not affiliated with FEMA, NYC OMB, New York State, or the City of New York.
meta.flagDisclaimer: Analytical flags are screening indicators only and do not represent findings of non-compliance, fraud, grant ineligibility, or improper expenditure.
